feedback: The confession follows the accusation's central chain: the live fall was invented, the rejected studio work furnished a cover story, and Dada's private-room visit supplied glass access. Taking poison during the preview specifies the transfer mechanism, but it is a confession of an already possible act rather than a new clue required to identify her. Her acknowledgment that erased credit cannot justify murder feels emotionally earned and connects to the earlier conversations with Vincent. Brie and Chip's shorter resolutions preserve ordinary obligations and shame without competing with the confession. I found the ending satisfying, though the physical case before voting remained probabilistic because no observation directly linked Dada to the bottle tampering.
